description: Earlier this month, my opponent bragged online about commuting from his Tahoe home to Sacramento for session. "From the lake to the swamp in one morning" he said. As if we're supposed to take pity on him for having to endure "the swamp" to represent us. We called him out of course. I mean, it's easy to say this when his commute is paid for by the taxpayers!
